en.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)
en.description: Credit-linked subsidy and affordable housing support for urban poor/EWS/LIG/MIG to own a pucca house.
en.eligibility: Urban households in EWS/LIG/MIG categories with no pucca house; income and property criteria apply.
en.benefits: Interest subsidy on home loan (CLSS) and support for house construction.
application_steps: Enter Aadhaar, income, bank, property details.
faqs: How do I apply for PMAY subsidy?
